sections.label: About Us
sections.quote: “If you are looking for a cheap deal, we are not going to be it. We are going to be your best, highest quality bid.”
sections.caption: Matt Faber · Owner
paragraphs: Matt Faber owns Faber Concrete. It is a separate company on purpose. A page that sells roofs and driveways together reads like a jack of all trades, and concrete is a specialty. Fewer companies even know how to do it, and a lot of the ones who do never advertise. This site is only the slab.

We never pour a four-inch driveway. Five inches, every time, no matter the driveway, and six inches on the approach. That is an inch more than what most contractors pour, on the driveway and again where it meets the street. They skip it because it is cheaper, on the order of $600 to $700 on an average driveway. Matt tells people, when he gives the estimate, that if they are looking for a cheap deal, this is not it. The bid is the highest quality one, priced down the middle, with a superior finish.

The extra inch is there because Michigan is cold, and because a 20-ton delivery truck uses a driveway. A thinner slab can crack enough that you hate it long before you are ready to replace it. That is the expensive failure. It is not always bad enough to tear out this year. It is bad enough that you live with a driveway you do not like.

Thickness does not save a slab on the wrong ground. We never pour over dirt. We never compact a layer of sand and call it a base. That sand shortcut saves a few hundred dollars, and the ground under the slab can erode out. We grade 21AA across the whole area, compact it, then form, then pour. The finishers have been finishing concrete for more than 25 years. After the site look, Matt writes a contract, not only an estimate.

areas.body: This site is only the concrete company. If the address fits, the driveway is five inches, never four, and the approach is six. Under it is 21AA, graded across the whole area and compacted before anyone forms or pours. We never pour over dirt, and we do not compact sand and call it a base. Skipping that inch saves the other crew on the order of $600 to $700 on an average driveway. A sand base saves a few hundred dollars. privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Faber Concrete collects, uses, and protects your information when you request an estimate in Metro Detroit and Wayne, Oakland, Macomb, Washtenaw, and Livingston counties.

paragraphs: This Privacy Policy explains how Faber Concrete (“we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and shares information when you visit our website, request service, schedule an appointment, or otherwise contact us. The practices described here reflect how a Farmington Hills / Wayne, Oakland, Macomb, Washtenaw, and Livingston counties concrete company typically handles customer data.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect information you provide directly, including:
list: Name, phone number, email address, and property address
Service details and project notes
Preferred appointment windows and messages you send through forms or chat
Photos or documents you voluntarily upload related to a job

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may also collect limited technical information automatically, such as:
list: Browser type, device type, approximate location derived from IP address
Pages visited, referral source, and general site-usage metrics
Cookies or similar technologies used for basic analytics and site performance

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Information
paragraphs: We use collected information to:
list: Respond to service, estimate, and appointment requests
Schedule appointments, coordinate crews, and communicate project updates
Provide quotes, warranties, and post-project follow-up
Improve our website, services, and local service coverage
Send marketing messages only when you have opted in
Comply with legal obligations and protect against fraud or misuse

sections.heading: 3. SMS & Phone Communications
paragraphs: If you provide a phone number and consent to be contacted, we may call or text you about your estimate, consultation, or project status. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out of SMS at any time; reply HELP for help. SMS consent is not a condition of purchase and is not sold or shared with third parties for their own marketing.

sections.heading: 4. How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:
list: Service providers who help us operate forms, hosting, analytics, or communications
Financing partners, only when you request financing options
Insurance carriers or adjusters, only when you ask us to support a claim
Professional advisors or authorities when required by law or to protect our rights
sections.closing: Any vendors we use are expected to process information only as needed to perform services for us and to protect it with reasonable safeguards.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies & Analytics
paragraphs: Our site may use cookies or similar tools to remember preferences, measure traffic, and understand how visitors find our services. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some site features.

sections.heading: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: We keep estimate and project-related information for as long as needed to provide services, maintain warranty records, resolve disputes, and meet legal or accounting requirements. When information is no longer needed, we delete or de-identify it when reasonably practical.

sections.heading: 7. Your Choices & Rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to:
list: Request access to personal information we hold about you
Ask us to correct inaccurate information
Request deletion of information, subject to legal or warranty retention needs
Opt out of marketing emails or texts
sections.closing: To make a request, contact us using the details below. We may need to verify your identity before fulfilling certain requests.

sections.heading: 8. Children’s Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are intended for adults seeking residential and commercial concrete work. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has submitted information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: 9. Data Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect information submitted through our site. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 10. Third-Party Links
paragraphs: Our website may link to Google Maps, financing partners, or other third-party sites. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, not this one.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top will change when we do. Continued use of the site after updates means you acknowledge the revised policy.

sections.heading: 12. Contact Us
